Name: FS - Cozy Scarves
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/EqBgtTY.png[/img][size=3]﻿
Cozy Scarves is a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] pack which adds over 15 animated and recolorable scarf accessories via the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/FashionSense/wiki/Hand-Mirror-Tool]Hand Mirror[/url] tool.
[/size]

[img]https://imgur.com/GyuRdl9.png[/img]﻿
[img]https://imgur.com/aMs3Fce.gif[/img]﻿


[img]https://imgur.com/ENnsIee.png[/img]﻿
[size=6][b]Cozy Scarves[/b][/size]
These bulky scarves come in several variations, many of which are recolorable!
[img]https://imgur.com/ViEbqGA.gif[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/cst99ov.gif[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/7y0pbPM.gif[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/XGhU4R3.gif[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/qhWLtzb.gif[/img]


[size=6][b]Small Scarves[/b][/size]
These small scarves are perfect for everyday wear!
[img]https://imgur.com/p8J1moC.gif[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/cB7jCEj.gif[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/4aKizOB.gif[/img]


[size=6][b]Warm Scarves[/b][/size]
These scarves will occasionally show your character's breath. Perfect for those cold seasons!
[img]https://imgur.com/unKkbTY.gif[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/Ij0ZkWa.gif[/img]


[img]https://imgur.com/fP5yPeU.png[/img]
[b][size=3]How do I wear one of the scarves?[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Use the Hand Mirror tool from the Fashion Sense framework and select the "accessories" button.[/size]
[/list]
